title: From FAANG to MANGOS — Wall Street is searching for the next 'Magnificent 7': Chart of the Day
title_zh: 从 FAANG 到 MANGOS——华尔街正在寻找下一个“Magnificent 7”：每日图表
summary: Wall Street loves a new nickname for its favorite trade.
summary_zh: 华尔街喜欢为其最喜爱的交易取一个新绰号。

title: How SpaceX benefits from its Cursor acquisition
title_zh: SpaceX 如何从收购 Cursor 中获益
summary: SpaceX's SpaceXAI should get a solid boost from its Cursor acquisition, but it will still need to compete with rivals like OpenAI and Anthropic.
summary_zh: SpaceX 旗下的 SpaceXAI 应该会从 Cursor 收购中获得坚实的推动力，但它仍然需要与 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等竞争对手竞争。

title: The stock market's next leg higher may not come from AI: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 股市的下一轮上涨可能不是来自人工智能：每日图表
summary: After months of AI dominance and a week of SpaceX frenzy, the setup for stocks is becoming broader.
summary_zh: 经过几个月的人工智能统治和一周的 SpaceX 疯狂之后，股票的格局正在变得更加广泛。
